notes_for_editor: Two sources only: the Forest Lookouts record (dated repairs, land purchase, 'Removed' status) and the NGS datasheet (1962 description and a 6 Feb 2024 history entry rating the marker GOOD). Neither gives a build year or a removal date; a web search for removal found nothing. The record page carries 'November 2015 - Bob Frakes photo' but no image URL, so no photos entry was added. The brief coordinates match the NGS position to within about 0.001 degree. Access is not stated in either source, so no access fact was written.
